# Lane 2.49: divisions and venues screens (note of 2026-11-22)

Replaces the old copy of messages. Branch `lane/2.49-divisions-venues`; not pushed (the lead pushes).

## What the lane holds

- Divisions screen, `[league]/admin/season/divisions` (`apps/web/src/features/divisions-area`): add, rename, color, order (up/down) and remove a season's divisions; a division that holds teams offers no remove button and says why (A-17 as changed); remove asks first (a tick) and answers "Removed" with "Put it back". Owner and admins only.
- Venues screen, `[league]/admin/schedule/venues` (`apps/web/src/features/venues-area`), linked from the schedule screen: add, rename, order and remove venues and courts; a court or venue with games to come keeps no remove button and says how many (read `countPlaceGames`, core `scheduling/place-games.ts`, database `find-place-games.ts`). Schedulers may use it.
- D-L6 (A-5): `restore_venue` and `restore_court` also accept `venues.manage`, so the scheduler who removed one can put it back; role-matrix rows follow.
- Shared form pieces `apps/web/src/features/list-forms` (record 067: a refused save keeps what was typed, marked, said beside the box). Messages in `packages/site/src/messages/en/admin-divisions.ts`, `admin-venues.ts`.
- Done test: `tests/browser/divisions-venues-test.mjs` (two divisions, a venue with two courts, at 390 by taps, scripts on and off, refusals, who may); page-step cases in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs`; pictures in `scripts/shots.mjs`.
- Merge of `build/stage-1` (321 commits) on 2026-11-22, commit a014af9b. Conflicts: `saved-notice.ts` (screen list and comment, both sides kept), `countPlaceGames` beside `countTeamGames` in `packages/core/src/commands.ts` and `role-matrix.test.ts`.
